heading: A Vocabulary of the Language of Lord North's Island, called by the Natives Tóbi

book.short: Remarks on the Language and Inhabitants of Lord North's Island
book.title: Remarks on the Language and Inhabitants of Lord North's Island, in the Indian Archipelago; with a Vocabulary
book.author: John Pickering
book.imprint: Memoirs of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences, new series, vol. 2, 1846, pp. 235–242

scan.rights: Public domain scan; image via Internet Archive

transcription: Transcribed from the scan; spellings kept as printed
about: Compiled by Pickering from Horace Holden, an American seaman held on the island with Benjamin Nute from December 1832 to November 1834 after a shipwreck.
